page.overview:
What is Chatot?

Although he means well, he can be somewhat hotheaded. His personality is also somewhat erratic, but to a lesser extent than Wigglytuff. Though he always has the Guild's best intentions at heart, he's known to be rather harsh, such as sending the players to bed without taking supper for failing a mission without allowing them to explain themselves. He is somewhat paranoid, mostly about Wigglytuff getting mad, and sleeps at the top of the ladder out of the guild to ensure no one runs away. He is shown to care deeply for the Guild members, but will sometimes deny it, claiming his actions are for the Guild's best interests. He, like most everyone, fell for Dusknoir's lies and had a lot of respect for him, shown by how much convincing it took for him to believe the team's story after they escape the future.

Chatot oversees Bidoof's early training at the guild. During one of his many goof-ups, Bidoof eats Wigglytuff's supply of Perfect Apples and is punished by a frantic Chatot with no dinner. One day, Chatot assigns Bidoof to check the number of Oran Berries and when Bidoof expresses his disappoint at his lack of progress, Chatot assures him that he just needs patience to reach his goal of becoming a great explorer.

After Bidoof talks to Snover about visiting Star Cave to have their wishes granted, Bidoof asks Chatot for a day off under the claim of having a stomachache. Chatot is suspicious of this due to Bidoof's iron-clad stomach, but grants him the day off.

When Bidoof is cornered by Team Rouge, Chatot appears with the rest of the guild and helps send Team Rouge packing. Afterward, Chatot reveals he was suspicious of what Bidoof was up to and brought the guild with him to check it out. He later helps keep Wigglytuff from going after Jirachi along with the rest of the guild, but struggles against Wigglytuff's might.
